duplicates.notes: The same slug identifies the weighed successor. The historical predecessor is quarantined.

ingredients.notes: Corn, plain wheat flour and water preserve the 250:100:100 ratio of Helo Indonesia at 80%. Spring onion and salt are weighed. Pan oil is 30 g.

method.notes: Rasa Indonesia independently supports the pan method and thin roughly quarter-cup portions. The public recipe gives an estimated time and a doneness cue.

food_safety.notes: Wheat (gluten) declared in each locale. Cook the flour batter all the way through before serving and avoid tasting it raw.

servings_and_time.notes: About six thin fritters for two servings. This is a portioning estimate. No physical cooking trial.

nutrition.notes: Reviewed the raw edible sources. Unknown retention of the 30 g of pan oil requires withholding all four numeric macros.

glycemic.notes: The new batter and preparation lack a traceable matching measured GI for a numerical GK calculation.
